name: pterm
description: ✨ PTerm is a modern Go module to easily beautify console output. Featuring charts, progressbars, tables, trees, text input, select menus and much more 🚀 It's completely configurable and 100% cross-platform compatible.

latest_release.name: v0.12.84
latest_release.body:
<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at master -->

## What's Changed
### Exciting New Features 🎉
* feat(logger): preserve slog argument order and add SortArguments option by @ChrisJr404 in https://github.com/pterm/pterm/pull/808
* feat(table): add WithColumnMinWidths to set minimum column widths by @ChrisJr404 in https://github.com/pterm/pterm/pull/809
* feat: add style to interactive select by @afbjorklund in https://github.com/pterm/pterm/pull/796
* feat: make input prompt customizable by @Urban20 in https://github.com/pterm/pterm/pull/810
* feat(table): support custom box printer configuration for table rendering by @AdamMagued in https://github.com/pterm/pterm/pull/814
### Fixes 🔧
* fix: use cancellation signal in InteractiveContinuePrinter for proper Ctrl+C cleanup by @Yanhu007 in https://github.com/pterm/pterm/pull/775
* fix: update vertical line character in BoxPrinter by @MarvinJWendt in https://github.com/pterm/pterm/pull/780
* fix(prefix): calculate multi-line indent using visual width for wide characters by @AdamMagued in https://github.com/pterm/pterm/pull/813
* fix(area): wrap long lines before updating by @linhdmn in https://github.com/pterm/pterm/pull/811
* fix: respect fuzzy filter when selecting/deselecting all in InteractiveMultiselect by @nghiack7 in https://github.com/pterm/pterm/pull/781
* fix: multi-line text input with a default value does not return when Enter is pressed by @Homoarea in https://github.com/pterm/pterm/pull/804
### Other Changes
* ci: consolidate CI workflows into go.yml and enhance testing by @MarvinJWendt in https://github.com/pterm/pterm/pull/776

## New Contributors
* @Yanhu007 made their first contribution in https://github.com/pterm/pterm/pull/775
* @AdamMagued made their first contribution in https://github.com/pterm/pterm/pull/813
* @linhdmn made their first contribution in https://github.com/pterm/pterm/pull/811

* @Homoarea made their first contribution in https://github.com/pterm/pterm/pull/804
* @ChrisJr404 made their first contribution in https://github.com/pterm/pterm/pull/808
* @afbjorklund made their first contribution in https://github.com/pterm/pterm/pull/796
* @Urban20 made their first contribution in https://github.com/pterm/pterm/pull/810

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/pterm/pterm/compare/v0.12.83...v0.12.84
